note: The only outside opinion this family has left.
Every other check on the loudness chain measures its output with the same
function that decided the gain, which is circular: a wrong BS.1770 would
satisfy all of them. These three were produced by ffmpeg's ebur128 reading
WAV files the module itself wrote, on the last day mitreden still had a
Python half with real ffmpeg in it. Neither consumer has one now.
440 Hz is here on purpose. K-weighting is deliberately not flat there, so a
tone off 1 kHz catches a filter that is merely plausible.
If these drift the fault is in level.ts, not in the numbers. Do not
re-derive them from the code under test — that is the circle they exist to
break. conformance/calibrate.sh regenerates them from ffmpeg on any machine
measured_with: ffmpeg ebur128, integrated loudness, on WAV written by encodeWav
